ruview.erase: Erase all settings and recordings on this board

ruview.save_first: Save changes before testing or configuring boards.
ruview.quality: Experimental Wi-Fi motion detection (radar, including through walls). RSSI needs a supported host adapter; CSI needs optional ESP32 boards. Demo data is labelled. Model/LoRA switching is unavailable in this upstream version.
ruview.prerequisites: Use HTTPS or localhost and a browser with Web Serial enabled. Close other serial tools; use a data-capable USB cable. Hold BOOT while reconnecting if detection fails.
ruview.privacy: Wi-Fi credentials stay in browser memory and go directly to the board. Firmware, configuration and fresh sensor data are confirmed separately.

ruview.verification_failed: Verification failed. Nothing is retried automatically. Check the firmware files, USB connection and board before another attempt.

ruview.source_mismatch: Experimental Wi-Fi motion detection (radar, including through walls). RSSI needs a supported host adapter; CSI needs optional ESP32 boards. Demo data is labelled. Model/LoRA switching is unavailable in this upstream version.
ruview.fusion_notice: Pose-Fusion uses untrained example models. Its visualization and confidence scores are not validated measurements.
ruview.mode_help_docker: AuraGo manages RuView in Docker. Suitable for ESP32 boards or a demo.
ruview.mode_help_external: Connect an existing RuView instance. Install and start it on its own computer.
ruview.mode_help_native: For Wi-Fi adapters on Windows or macOS. If AuraGo runs in Docker or on Linux, choose an external instance.
ruview.source_help_esp32: Real CSI measurements with optional ESP32-S3 or ESP32-C6 boards. Set them up over USB below.
ruview.source_help_wifi: Motion detection using the RuView computer's Wi-Fi adapter. Requires Windows or macOS and a native or external instance.
ruview.source_help_simulated: Try it without hardware. All generated data is explicitly labelled as demo data.
ruview.readonly_help: Prevents changes. Turn off Read only to start the runtime or set up a board.
ruview.agent_help: The agent can only read status and measurements. It cannot configure boards or start recordings.
ruview.token_help: Optional for protected external instances. Encrypted in the Vault when you save.
ruview.managed_help: Save your settings and open RuView to install or start the runtime.
ruview.setup_help: Choose receiver → save settings → connect board over USB → set up firmware and Wi-Fi → check sensor data.
ruview.receiver_help: Private IPv4 address of the computer running RuView, reachable by the board over Wi-Fi. Example: 192.168.1.20.
ruview.udp_help: Allows sensor data from your boards. Choose the local LAN address and the allowed board addresses.
ruview.udp_allow_help: Separate board addresses with commas. A whole network is also supported, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.
ruview.enable_first: Enable RuView and save your settings before continuing.
ruview.write_first: Turn off Read only under Permissions and save to set up a board.
ruview.wifi_mode: Host Wi-Fi requires a native or external instance. Choose that runtime or another data source.
